trails.name: Mount Junfeng
trails.why: Jun Peak Mountain is located in the Three Rivers Township, Yunnan Township, Yunnan County, Jiangsu Province, China. The summit of Jun Peak is 1760 meters above sea level. It is the first peak in the city of Yunnan.

trails.name: Tiantangzhai summit
trails.why: Tiãntángzhài is the second highest peak of the Dabie Mountains located on the border between Hubei and Anhui provinces in the People's Republic of China.

trails.name: Mount Wudang
trails.why: The name of Mount Shenyang, a mountain of Taiyuan, a mountain of Taiyuan, also known as Mount Liang, East Jinping and China, is derived from the name of Mount Shiro, a mountain in northwestern Hubei province.

trails.name: Mount Song
trails.why: Mount Song is a mountain in central China's Henan Province, along the southern bank of the Yellow River, that is known as the central mountain of the Five Great Mountains of China.

trails.name: Yunmengshan summit
trails.why: Yunmun Mountain National Forest Park is a national forest park located in the Miyuan and Weiju districts of Beijing, China, established in November 1995 and covering an area of 22.08 square kilometers, it is a national 3A tourist attraction.

trails.name: Mount Jiuhua
trails.why: Mount Jiuhua located in Chizhou, Anhui Province in China is an important Buddhist site and natural scenic spot.

trails.name: Jizhen Mountain summit
trails.why: Mount Jizhen is the second highest mountain in Guangzhou, China, with an altitude of 1,175 metres, just 35 meters lower than Tiantang Peak.

trails.name: Qiniangshan summit
trails.why: Qiniangshan is a mountain in Nan'ao Subdistrict, Dapeng Peninsula. At 869 metres above sea level, it is the second tallest mountain in Shenzhen after Wutongshan.

trails.name: Weibao Mountain summit
trails.why: Hubei Mountain, formerly known as Hubei Mountain, is a mountain range in Hubei Province, Jiangsu Province, Yunnan Province. It is located about 10 kilometres south of the city of Hubei, at an altitude of 2509 meters.
